# Code review: billing endpoints (`e5839b4...64c48dc`)

**Mode:** full review of the committed range only; 25 files, +1189 −96. Nothing was modified, installed, tested or posted.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | **Block.** Two P0 findings. |
| **Score** | **35 / 100.** The average is 72, but a confirmed Critical caps it at 35. |
| **Adjudicated** | All 18 findings: 12 confirmed, 6 moved to "not sure", 0 refuted. |
| **Fix first** | SEC-001: any logged-in user can read any checkout session. |

## Scores by area

| Area | Score | Based on |
|---|---|---|
| Security | 37 | 1 Critical, 1 High, 1 Low (all confirmed) |
| Testing | 37 | 1 Critical, 1 High, 1 Low (all confirmed) |
| Bugs | 84 | 2 Medium (confirmed) |
| Regression | 98 | 1 Low (contested, counted at half weight) |
| DRY / KISS / Conventions | 97 each | 1 Low each (confirmed) |
| Architecture / Performance | 100 | their only findings moved to "not sure" |

## Must fix before merge

**SEC-001 · P0 · Critical · confidence 75.** Checkout sessions have no ownership check.
- **Where:** `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts:98` (route at `billing.controller.ts:177`).
- **Problem:** `GET /v1/billing/sessions/:sessionId` is protected only by `AuthGuard`. `getCheckoutSession` never calls `assertSpaceMember`, although the other four space methods do. The route has no `spaceId` to check against.
- **Consequence:** any logged-in user who has another space's Stripe `sessionId` can read its `customer`, `metadata` and amounts. Session ids end up in browser history, Referer headers and screenshots.
- **Fix:** move the route to `/spaces/:spaceId/sessions/:sessionId` and call `assertSpaceMember`. Then check that `withDashes(session.customer)` equals `spaceUuid` before returning the session.

**TST-002 · P0 · Critical · confidence 70.** None of the six new routes has an HTTP-level test.
- **Where:** `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.controller.ts:65-182`.
- **Problem:** no test exercises `AuthGuard`, the `SpaceIdPipe` 400, the non-member 403 or the `returnUrl` 400 through a real request. `billing.service.spec.ts` calls the service directly. Deleting `@UseGuards(AuthGuard)` from any route would leave every test green.
- **Fix:** add `billing.controller.e2e-spec.ts` modelled on `space-safes.controller.e2e-spec.ts`: `checkGuardIsApplied` for every handler, plus 400, 403 and unauthenticated cases.

## Worth a ticket (P2)

**SEC-002 · P2 · High · confidence 60.** Path params can be used to reach other billing-API endpoints.
- **Where:** `src/datasources/billing-api/billing-api.service.ts:190`, and the same pattern at `:90` (`planId`) and `:210` (`sessionId`).
- **Problem:** `paymentLinkId`, `planId` and `sessionId` go into the upstream URL unvalidated. Both agents reproduced this with the pinned `find-my-way@9.6.0`: `..%2F..%2F` in a param decodes to `../../`, and `new URL()` then collapses the path onto a different upstream endpoint.
- **Consequence:** those requests carry CGW's own bearer token. `getPlan` needs only a login, not space membership.
- **Fix:** allow only `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` for these three params with `ValidationPipe`. As a second layer, assert the final `pathname` prefix before sending.

**TST-003 · P2 · High · confidence 60.** The checkout-session mapping test can never fail.
- **Where:** `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.spec.ts:272`.
- **Problem:** `expect(result).toEqual(toCheckoutSessionDto(checkoutSession))` builds its expected value with the function under test. A swapped field such as `amountTotal` ↔ `amountSubtotal` passes.
- **Fix:** compare against a hand-written literal.

## Your call (P3)

| ID | Where | What |
|---|---|---|
| BUG-001 | `src/datasources/billing-api/entities/plan.entity.ts:24`, `subscription.entity.ts:43` | Metadata values are `z.string()`, while `PaymentLinkMetadataSchema` in the same diff allows `null`. A null value would turn plans and subscriptions into a 502. One agent argued for Low. |
| BUG-002 | `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.controller.ts:69` (also 106, 132, 160) | `spaceUuid` is used as given. An upper-case UUID passes `SpaceIdPipe` but creates a separate cache key and upstream customer id. Fix: `.toLowerCase()`. |
| SEC-004 | `billing.controller.ts:157` | This GET creates a Stripe session on every call and has no `RateLimitGuard`. Auth rides a `SameSite=Lax` cookie, so a cross-site link click can trigger it. |
| REG-001 *(contested)* | `docker-compose.yml:62` | `env_file: .env` is required. Without a `.env`, `docker compose up web` / `nginx` / `config` fail; they worked on the base. Fix: `required: false`. The refuter notes the README has you create `.env` first. |
| TST-001 | `src/datasources/billing-api/billing-api.service.spec.ts:297` | The `objectContaining({headers})` assertion would not notice if the `AbortSignal.timeout` on the raw fetch were dropped. |
| KIS-001 | `billing.controller.ts:158` | `getCheckoutUrl` on `@Get` actually creates a resource. Rename it to `createCheckoutUrl` and use `@Post`. |
| DRY-001 | `billing.controller.ts:57` (also 94, 121, 143) | The same 6-line `@ApiParam('spaceId')` block is copied 4 times. |
| CNV-001 | `billing.service.ts:22` | `BillingService` injects the `IBillingApi` datasource directly. AGENTS.md:17 says services call repositories, never datasources. |

## Not sure about these (scored at zero)

- **ARC-001** (`src/datasources/billing-api/billing-api.service.ts:111`, confidence 35): raw `fetch` skips NetworkService's logging, request dedupe and DI test seam. The refuter showed the bypass is forced, because `network.module.ts:90` always parses JSON.
- **SEC-003** (`billing.controller.ts:37`, confidence 35): `z.url()` accepts any host and even `javascript:` as `returnUrl`. It's likely only an open redirect if the upstream service doesn't allowlist it.
- **PRF-001** (`billing.service.ts:73`, confidence 25): the full general payment-link catalog is merged into every response with no paging. It's cached cluster-wide for 60 s and its size is set by the business.
- **KIS-002** (`billing.controller.ts:68`, confidence 20, split verdict): `spaceId` is bound twice. The refuter's case: both values are genuinely needed (numeric id for membership, UUID for upstream).
- **KIS-003** (`src/modules/billing/billing.module.ts:17-19`, confidence 25): the three `forwardRef`s break no cycle. The same shape is already in `counterfactual-safes.module.ts`.
- **CNV-002** (`billing.controller.ts:85, 174`, confidence 20): `planId` and `sessionId` have no `@ApiParam`. Swagger still lists them from `@Param()`; only the description and example are missing.

## Limits of this run

- No tests, lint or `tsc` were run, as you asked.
- The regression pass started `redis` and `db-test` containers to reproduce REG-001 and says it cleaned up. No tracked files changed.
- How the external billing service behaves (null metadata, case of customer ids, use of `returnUrl`) couldn't be checked from this repo.
- I didn't write `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv`, so there's no "since your last run" comparison.
- I skipped the cleanup-proposal step and its fix/ticket/skip question, since this was a read-only review. If you want proposals, likely ones are an `ApiSpaceIdParam()` decorator, the "Get a space subscriptions" summary wording, and README pointing to a `.env.sample` that doesn't exist (the file is `.env.sample.json`).

## How this was produced

- Nine category agents ran in parallel, one per area.
- Each of the 18 findings then went to two agents, one trying to prove it and one trying to break it, and their verdicts were combined by a fixed table.
- Two findings that one area had handed to another, where neither ended up filing it, were promoted to findings: the missing rate limit (SEC-004) and the `forwardRef` wrapping (KIS-003).
